prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 19 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1253; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of neck pain and stiffness. Examination documented cervical muscle tenderness and restricted range of motion, consistent with a cervical strain mechanism for a crash of this type. Over the course of 19 visits, care included manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction. The treatment followed a typical course and was gradually reduced in frequency as symptoms improved. Nearly all reported symptoms are based on the patient's own descriptions of pain, as cervical imaging and standard neurological and orthopedic provocation tests were within normal limits. No prior injury to the cervical spine or neck region is known to this provider. Billed services reflect single charges for each visit and no repeated or duplicate entries. Current status is improving, with the patient able to resume most daily activities. Ongoing home exercise is recommended, with reassessment if symptoms worsen.
